rights_basis: Separate bounded transcriptions of two actual prayers printed in the US-public-domain1862 book. Underlying Latin and response words remain public domain; project metadata does not relicense them.
text: Refecti participatione muneris sacri, quaesumus Domine Deus noster: ut cujus exsequimur cultum, intercedente beato Ignatio Martyre tuo, atque Pontifice, sentiamus effectum. Per Dominum.
